description: gcamland implements the land-allocation component of GCAM as an offline R model. The Joint Global Change Research Institute provides routines that convert commodity prices and agricultural productivity assumptions into land allocations. The documentation supports single runs and ensembles, including hindcasts from 1975 to 2010 and projections from 2010 to 2100. Geographic and land-category detail follow the configured GCAM inputs. The model can support land-use, agricultural supply and bioenergy scenarios relevant to infrastructure planning. Source code is free under GPL-2.0 and the repository documents its R workflow. It is related to GCAM but allows land-allocation experiments without running the complete integrated assessment model. A limitation is that externally supplied prices and productivity assumptions replace feedbacks that would otherwise arise within the full model. The documented periods describe supported experiments, not validated forecasts. No input database or ensemble output was downloaded and no allocation scenario was run.
name: gcamland offline land allocation model
notes: G5 G5-0267. Software checked through metadata and documentation, without installation or execution. Geographic scope follows the documented application or software portability; it does not imply validation throughout that area.
